text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon marks a magnificent debut 
race with a spectacular win!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
In the same generation, there is also 
Narita Brian, who is said to be the 
strongest contender for the Classic Triple 
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
What kind of races will she show us moving 
forward? I can't wait to see!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I totally owned my Make Debut, 
Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Well, but the real deal starts 
right here.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If I wanna throw down in some crazy 
1-on-1s, I gotta keep climbing all the way 
to the top!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon is overflowing with unusual 
motivation. To answer her drive, I hurry 
to plan her next race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Hishi Amazon desires is to battle the 
strong. If so, the grandest stage possible 
would be best.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if I remember right... was it a Junior 
Class GⅠ?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aggressively aiming for GIs starting next 
year? Sounds good to me. Count me in! Next 
up is the Hanshin JF!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I started walking away from Nakayama 
Racecourse— I was stopped by Hishi Amazon, 
wearing a serious expression.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—The Make Debut is over, and the next 
target race has been decided.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Before everything kicks off from here, 
there's something I wanted to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"There's someone in the Twinkle Series I 
absolutely have to settle the score with, 
one-on-one."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heheh... You already know, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It's "Narita Brian"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian—an Umamusume so strong that 
even the Trainers whisper about her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I knew Hishi Amazon had held her in high 
regard for quite some time.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: She's a beast, ya know, Trainy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Right after I enrolled, I picked 
a fight with her one-on-one, and I 
couldn't beat her at all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I was frustrated, I wanted so badly to 
win, so I started chasing after it—and 
before long, I realized.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
The reason she runs isn't because she 
wants glory, or to give people courage, or 
anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"There's a beast inside her. She runs 
because she simply can't help running. 
That's why she's so strong...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Going head-to-head with her makes my soul 
tremble! If we can clash on a grand stage, 
man, it's gonna be beyond insane!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanna go one-on-one with her 
in an exceptionally dazzling place!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon's eyes were blazing fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
This is... absolute, no matter what. 
Engrave it into your heart, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And right at that moment...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Brian!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well isn't this serendipity at its finest! 
Today's my debut race—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You were actually there to watch!? YOU 
were!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk. I was just passing by.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? You just came 
in from the entrance, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, hehehe!! Man, really? ...Is that 
so!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's "Hishi Amazon's" debut race, after 
all! Guess you were a little curious too, 
huh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
This is... Heh, I never saw this coming! 
Thanks, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Let's both do our best in the Twinkle 
Series!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What, getting all shy now?! Hey, your tape 
is crooked!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Leave it alone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Have you decided on dinner yet!? 
Wanna grab a bite together if you're 
free?!
choice_data_list:
(They're on really good terms, aren't 
they?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, the debut race was safely 
behind us. Next up is the Hanshin JF. The 
challenge on the grand stage begins!
